tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: ExamPrepAI is a Next.js application that uses Google Gemini AI to automatically generate study materials (important questions and quick revision notes) from uploaded PDF and image files.

tour.title: Authentication & Middleware
tour.description: Clerk authentication middleware protects all routes. The proxy.ts file configures the middleware matcher, while the root layout wraps the app with ClerkProvider for sign-in/sign-up flows.

tour.title: Dashboard Layout
tour.description: The authenticated dashboard area has a persistent layout with a Sidebar navigation menu and a Navbar search bar. All dashboard pages render within this shell.

tour.title: Upload & Generate Study Materials
tour.description: The core upload flow lives in generate-notes-upload.tsx. Users drag-and-drop PDFs or images, fill in title/subject, and submit. Files are uploaded to Vercel Blob, then background processing begins. Upload progress is tracked with step-by-step status indicators.

tour.title: AI Content Processing Pipeline
tour.description: After upload, process-note.ts orchestrates the full extraction pipeline: PDF text extraction (or Gemini Vision for scanned PDFs/images), content chunking, and AI study material generation via Google Gemini. The pipeline runs asynchronously using Next.js after() to keep the serverless function alive.

tour.title: Gemini AI Integration
tour.description: The Gemini integration configures the generative AI model and handles prompt construction for generating important questions and quick revision points from extracted note content.

tour.title: Data Models & Database
tour.description: MongoDB stores notes and generated content chunks. Mongoose models define the schema for notes (with processing status tracking) and individual content chunks for paginated retrieval.

tour.title: Server Actions & API Routes
tour.description: Server actions (getAllNotes, getNoteById, getRecentNotes) query MongoDB for notes. API routes expose paginated endpoints for questions, revision items, and search with cursor-based pagination.

tour.title: Dashboard Pages & Notes Management
tour.description: The dashboard home shows a recent notes overview. The full notes listing page supports grid/list views, search, sort, and pagination. The note detail page displays full study materials with tabbed questions and revision content.

tour.title: Custom Hooks & Client Data Fetching
tour.description: Custom React hooks encapsulate data fetching logic: useNotes for paginated note listing, useNoteStatus for polling processing status, and useDebounce for search input debouncing.
